name: @epoch/agent-runtime
description: Epoch Agent Runtime service (W020): the long-running HOST MODEL over @epoch/agent-orchestration — tenant-scoped session lifecycle management, W010 event intake with idempotent duplicate suppression, the advance-on-event plan execution driver (typed state transitions, retry policies, cascade skips, settlement), proposal handoffs toward the Action Gateway boundary (W022, future) as typed data, and health/liveness as typed data. In-memory reference behavior: NO persistence, NO network, NO real processes; core logic stays pure (zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied).
